description: Where a run stalled. Returns the intervals in the log's timestamp column, longest first, each attributed to the line BEFORE it, which is what was running. Do this before reading a long log: a hang and slow progress are indistinguishable without it. If every line carries the same timestamp the capture was buffered and the log cannot answer the question at all, which this reports as an error.

estate.description: Which estate. Optional when only one is configured.

name.description: Log filename. Omit for the most recent.
